Arsenal Defeats Lille in Champions League Match

Arsenal secured a 3-0 victory over Lille in a UEFA Champions League match, extending their winning streak in the competition. Jurrien Timber, Eberechi Eze, and Bukayo Saka scored the goals in the second half. Arsenal players wore black armbands during the game.
